legs.summary: Climb the ladder at the Ravine-Veiled Village into the Ruin-Strewn Precipice dungeon. Fight through the magma-infested cliffs to Magma Wyrm Makar and take the lift at the top to emerge on Altus Plateau. This is the foot-approach alternative to the Grand Lift of Dectus (the lift requires both halves of the Dectus Medallion — one from Fort Haight in Limgrave, one from Fort Faroth in Caelid).

steps.text: From the Liurnia lake shore, follow the ravine northeast to the ladder at Ravine-Veiled Village. Ascend into the Ruin-Strewn Precipice cave.

steps.note: Chest in the second large chamber of the Ruin-Strewn Precipice, past the first set of magma slugs.

steps.text: Magma Wyrm Makar — boss of the Ruin-Strewn Precipice. NPC summon signs for Great Horned Tragoth and Millicent are near the fog gate. Defeating him drops a Dragon Heart and opens the lift to Altus Plateau.

steps.note: Dropped by Magma Wyrm Makar.
Stele on the road just northeast of the Altus Plateau grace, west of the Minor Erdtree.

steps.text: Ride northeast from the Abandoned Coffin grace. The Altus Plateau grace is near the Minor Erdtree on the road to the east.

legs.summary: Sweep the central plateau along the main road, collecting key items near the highway junction and meeting Corhyn who has followed you here. The Forest-Spanning Greatbridge grace is reached by continuing north; Goldmask stands on the broken bridge south of it.

steps.text: Head north along the main road from the Altus Plateau grace toward Leyndell. Avoid the Grace Mimic enemy near the Minor Erdtree — it mimics a Site of Grace and ambushes you.

Speak with Brother Corhyn near the Altus Highway Junction grace. He is searching for the prophet Goldmask. Tell him about the figure standing on the bridge to the south (Forest-Spanning Greatbridge — Goldmask is visible on the broken arch). Then ride south to the bridge and speak with Goldmask — he is silent.

steps.note: On a corpse by a chariot wreck south of Altus Highway Junction on the road.
Chest inside the minor dungeon/crypt beneath the Minor Erdtree church in this area.
Under the Minor Erdtree on the central Altus road — base of the golden tree.

Chest in the cellar of the Stormcaller Church ruins west of the highway.

legs.summary: Sweep the eastern half of the plateau past the Erdtree-Gazing Hill toward the Bower of Bounty. The Outer Wall Phantom Tree grace marks the Capital Outskirts entrance; hold off on entering Leyndell for now. Pick up items in the windmill area south of Bower of Bounty.

steps.text: Ride north from the Forest-Spanning Greatbridge. The Erdtree-Gazing Hill grace is on the cliffside overlook. Continue north past the Outer Wall Phantom Tree (Capital Outskirts starts here — come back later for Leyndell) toward the Bower of Bounty.

steps.note: Chest inside the Divine Tower of West Altus: Gate building — take the elevator up and loot the chest before the sealed tower gate.
Chest in a gazebo-like structure near the Rampartside Path grace, northeast of the main road.

Tower chest — in the Memory Tower at the top of the rise east of the Erdtree-Gazing Hill, guarded by a Lone Wolf.

legs.summary: The Windmill Villages are a celebration of the Godskin Apostle cult. Killing the Godskin Apostle at Dominula triggers a Millicent quest step. Pick up the unique Celebrant's weapons scattered throughout the village buildings and fields.

steps.text: Ride northwest from Bower of Bounty to the Windmill Village (Dominula). The villagers here dance endlessly in worship of the Godskin Apostle above.

steps.text: Godskin Apostle — at the top of Dominula, Windmill Village. Defeating him unlocks Windmill Heights grace and triggers Millicent's quest step.

After defeating the Godskin Apostle, speak to Millicent at the Windmill Heights Site of Grace. Exhaust her dialogue. She reflects on her goal and thanks you. Her questline continues in the Mountaintops of the Giants.

steps.note: Dropped by the Godskin Apostle at Dominula.

On a corpse near the village entrance path.

legs.summary: The Shaded Castle sits in a poison mire in the northwest corner of the plateau. It holds Valkyrie's Prosthesis (critical for Millicent's questline) and Marais Executioner's Sword from boss Elemer. Patches is also wounded here post-Volcano Manor and gives you Dancer's Castanets for the Tanith quest.

steps.text: From Road of Iniquity Side Path, ride northwest into the poison swamp and up into the Shaded Castle. The rampart entrance is to the south.

steps.note: Chest on the top floor of the Shaded Castle's northeast tower — navigate past the rampart enemies and up the ladder. CRITICAL for Millicent's questline: give it to her after this leg.
Chest in a sealed room inside the main keep.

steps.text: Elemer of the Briar — boss of the Shaded Castle, reached via Castellan's Hall grace. Attacks primarily with melee and his signature spells.

steps.text: After completing all Volcano Manor contracts (and thus after Rykard is dead), find Patches wounded in the Shaded Castle ramparts. Speak to him and exhaust his dialogue; he gives you Dancer's Castanets to return to Tanith at Volcano Manor.

steps.note: Given by Patches at the Shaded Castle after Rykard is defeated and all contracts are done.

legs.summary: Sweep the Capital Outskirts: the Outer Wall Battleground area (Dung Eater meets Boggart here), Hermit Merchant's Shack, the three dungeon graces (Auriza Side Tomb, Auriza Hero's Grave, Sealed Tunnel), and the Divine Tower of West Altus. Wrap up with the Capital Rampart grace before entering Leyndell proper.

steps.text: From Altus Highway Junction, ride northeast past the Outer Wall Phantom Tree toward Capital Rampart. The Outer Wall Battleground grace is on the east approach road.

steps.note: Dropped by Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger who invades at the Second Church of Marika (southeast of the Outer Wall Phantom Tree on the road toward the capital). MISSABLE: this crystal tear is needed for a specific Mohg, Lord of Blood survival mechanic; don't skip Eleonora.

steps.text: After freeing Dung Eater from the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds jail (done during Leyndell section) and receiving his message, return to the Outer Wall Battleground moat area. Find Boggart dying by the moat — loot a Seedbed Curse from his body. The Dung Eater then invades and can be defeated here for the Sword of Milos. Sword of Milos is in the Leyndell region file (it is in Leyndell cleanup).

missable.note: Boggart's death event and this Dung Eater invasion do not occur in the Ashen Capital — complete before burning the Erdtree.

legs.summary: Final Altus sweep: the Old Altus Tunnel and Altus Tunnel for somberstone/smithing stones and their bell bearings, plus the scattered field items including the Perfumer's Grotto, Sage's Cave, and remaining plateau collectibles.
